text.en: How many more triangles to make 300? How many bangles less than 300? Which is more, bangles or triangles?

The value of a digit depends on its place. In 280, the 2 is in the hundreds place so it is worth 200.
Comparing: 280 bangles and 250 triangles. Both have 2 hundreds, so compare tens. 8 tens is more than 5 tens, so 280 is more.
To find how many more triangles for 300, count from 250 up to 300: that is 50 more.
To find how many bangles less than 300, count from 280 up to 300: that is 20 less.
Use tiles to show numbers: a flat square tile is 100, a stick is ten, a small square is one.
To compare: first hundreds, then tens, then ones.

prompt.en: A friend says 250 is more than 280 because 5 is bigger than 0. What do you say?

points.en: Compare hundreds first, then tens, then ones.
The same digit has different values in different places.
